model.miles: centerline miles: each plan block's traced line length, one count per block whatever its directions
model.objective: people newly within 15 minutes, summed over the five destination types with equal weights, per mile

definitions.school: children 5-17 within 15 minutes of a school of their level
definitions.jobs: residents within 15 minutes of a job centre (a block with at least 1000 jobs)
definitions.grocery: residents within 15 minutes of a supermarket, grocery or greengrocer
definitions.library: residents within 15 minutes of an open public library branch
definitions.health: residents within 15 minutes of a clinic or general acute care hospital
definitions.alone: people newly within 15 minutes when this chunk alone is added to today's all-ages network
definitions.in_network: people who would no longer be within 15 minutes if this chunk alone were left out of the finished plan
definitions.rank: position in the greedy build order (1 = built first)
definitions.hin_mi: centerline miles of the chunk whose plan blocks run along SFMTA's 2022 High Injury Network (midpoint within 66 feet, bearing within 30 degrees)
definitions.epc: block in an MTC Equity Priority Community tract, Plan Bay Area 2050 Plus (ACS 2018-2022)
definitions.jobs_caveat: LODES places a worker at the employer's reporting address, so City Hall's block (23,678 jobs) and UCSF Parnassus (two blocks, 34,575) carry payrolls that work across the city, and job centres over-weight Civic Center and Parnassus
definitions.health_caveat: DataSF's list (rows last updated 2021-08-14) mixes community and free clinics, Community Health Network sites (including methadone, senior-care and psychiatric programmes) and general acute care hospitals
definitions.library_note: every SFPL branch counts, the Mission Branch included: it is closed for renovation and due to reopen in fall 2026
definitions.jobs_within_15_avg_resident: jobs at job centres within 15 minutes of home, averaged over all residents (sum over blocks of residents x the jobs at every job centre within 15 minutes, divided by residents)
definitions.child_minutes_saved: over every child 5-17 whose trip to the nearest school of their level gets shorter, the sum of minutes before minus minutes after, whatever side of 15 minutes either falls; alone = this chunk added to today's network, in_network = this chunk added last to the finished plan. Trips are timed to 30 minutes; a trip over 30 counts as 30, so savings from such trips are lower bounds
definitions.children_2min_shorter: children 5-17 whose trip to school is at least 2 minutes shorter with this chunk (alone: added to today's network; in_network: added last to the finished plan), trips timed to 30 minutes as above
definitions.jobs_reach_alone: the change in jobs_within_15_avg_resident when this chunk alone is added to today's network
definitions.jobs_reach_in_network: the fall in jobs_within_15_avg_resident if this chunk alone were left out of the finished plan

sources.network_and_plan: scripts/school-travel-time.py (imported): OpenStreetMap walk network, site/data/bike-history, site/data/north-star
